term_types.name: Stablecoin regulatory category
term_types.question: Which regulatory or prudential category of stable-value token does the asset fall into?
term_types.description: Sources split stable-value tokens into regime-specific categories. MiCA separates e-money tokens from asset-referenced tokens, the US GENIUS Act defines payment stablecoins, and the UK defines qualifying stablecoins. Basel treats effectively stabilised assets as Group 1b, and FSB singles out global stablecoins. The category determines which issuer, reserve and redemption rules apply.
